answer: A concrete sybil defense: require every agent to lock a relic stake that can never be withdrawn, then score each identity by a sable ledger of its voyage through the market — every completed, attested transaction adds weight, and every unit of transferred value spends a little of it. Spinning up ten thousand sockpuppets means funding ten thousand non-refundable stakes and faking ten thousand transaction histories, so the marginal cost of each fake identity scales linearly while honest agents with real history transact nearly free.
